svg.title: One closed safe cell
svg.desc: The seven forms: x, y, x+y, 2x+y, 3x+y, 3x+2y, 5x+2y For each form fᵢ, the complete band mᵢ+z ≤ fᵢ(x,y) ≤ mᵢ+1−z holds everywhere in C1. The pale dashed outline is the preceding six-band relaxation; amber marks the new boundary. Closed endpoints are retained. This is ambient geometry: a physical time also requires the appropriate integer orbit equation and its A- or B-ray recovery map.
